+def _resolver(data, preference, name_order):
+    packages = data["packages"]
+    features = set(data.get("features", []))
+    blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+    pins = data.get("pins", {})
+    names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+    best_vector = None
+    best = None
+
+    def visit(pending, chosen, edges):
+        nonlocal best_vector, best
+        if not pending:
+            # A package graph with any directed cycle is invalid.
+            done, active = set(), set()
+
+            def acyclic(name):
+                if name in active:
+                    return False
+                if name in done:
+                    return True
+                active.add(name)
+                if any(not acyclic(child) for child in edges.get(name, ())):
+                    return False
+                active.remove(name)
+                done.add(name)
+                return True
+
+            if not all(acyclic(name) for name in chosen):
+                return
+            vector = tuple(chosen.get(name, -1) for name in names)
+            if best_vector is None or (vector < best_vector if preference == "minimum" else vector > best_vector):
+                best_vector = vector
+                best = dict(chosen)
+            return
+
+        name, low, high = pending[0]
+        rest = pending[1:]
+        if name in chosen:
+            version = chosen[name]
+            if low <= version <= high:
+                visit(rest, chosen, edges)
+            return
+
+        rows = [row for row in packages[name]
+                if low <= row["version"] <= high
+                and row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name])]
+        rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["version"], reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+        for row in rows:
+            next_chosen = dict(chosen)
+            next_chosen[name] = row["version"]
+            next_edges = dict(edges)
+            active_deps = [dep for dep in row.get("deps", [])
+                           if not dep.get("feature") or dep["feature"] in features]
+            next_edges[name] = [dep["name"] for dep in active_deps]
+            next_pending = list(rest)
+            next_pending.extend((dep["name"], dep["min"], dep["max"]) for dep in active_deps)
+            visit(next_pending, next_chosen, next_edges)
+
+    initial = [(name, bounds[0], bounds[1]) for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()]
+    visit(initial, {}, {})
+    return {"versions": best} if best is not None else {"error": "unsatisfiable"}

+def _schedule(data):
+    jobs = [job for job in data["jobs"] if job["id"] not in data.get("blocked", [])]
+    k = data["k"]
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    for subset in combinations(jobs, k):
+        ids = tuple(sorted(job["id"] for job in subset))
+        idset = set(ids)
+        if not mandatory.issubset(idset):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in subset:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        ordered = sorted(subset, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"]))
+        if any(ordered[i]["end"] > ordered[i + 1]["start"]
+               for i in range(len(ordered) - 1)):
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+        if best_value is None or value > best_value or (value == best_value and ids < best_ids):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
